title: Youth Bridges Across the Balkans
shortDescription: A regional youth-led cooperation initiative connecting three Western Balkans cities through workshops, exchanges and a shared media platform.
fullDescription:
This project established cross-border working groups of young people aged 18–28 in Tirana, Pristina and Skopje to co-design and run cultural and civic projects across the three cities.

The project ran three exchange visits with peer mentoring, launched a youth-run regional media platform, and produced a cooperation toolkit freely available to other civil-society organisations.

title: Heritage Trails: Common Roots, Shared Futures
shortDescription: Three-country project mapping shared cultural heritage along historic routes and publishing the first regional Heritage Trails guide.
fullDescription:
The project documented 12 cross-border heritage sites linking Sarajevo, Cetinje and Belgrade. It produced the first regional Heritage Trails guide in print and digital form and trained 30 local guides.

Outputs included a 120-page printed guide in four languages, an interactive online map, and three documentary short films.

title: Women Entrepreneurs Without Borders
partners: Tirana Business Hub|Podgorica Women's Network|Skopje Female Founders
shortDescription: Cross-border mentorship and seed support for women-led small businesses in four Western Balkans countries.
fullDescription: The project pairs experienced entrepreneurs across four countries with women starting or scaling small businesses. It includes peer-mentoring circles, a cross-border online marketplace and quarterly in-person meet-ups.
